title: Lincoln High School WW2 Aircrash Memorial
memorial_details:
description: Louth and North Lincolnshire Advertiser - Saturday 26 July 1941 Page 4
BOMBER CRASHED INTO LINCOLN HOUSE 
Miss Edith Catherine Fowle senior French mistress at Lincoln Girls' High School, lost her life in a fire which broke out early on Tuesday morning at The Greestones, the staff boarding house on Greenstone Stirs. Lindum Road. Lincoln, after a British bomber crashed into it. The four occupants of the plane were killed. 
Miss Fowle, with four other members of the school staff, and housekeeper, were asleep in the house at the time, but all the others succeeded in escaping without injury, 
A German bomber and a British plane collided over the Home Counties on Monday night, and both were destroyed.
